modelRouting.routingRationale: One bounded independent Rust crate with frozen contract, no external effects, & module-local tests

objective: Complete & freeze M4 native Report rendering: validated deterministic JSON/SARIF/Markdown/HTML with preserved report status, visible coverage gaps, stable finding order, safe escaping, & no false clean.
integrationOwner: current orchestrator; sole owner of integration worktree HEAD, index, validation, commits, receipts, & push; may not edit worker-owned report files

interfaceLock.input: Only legion_contracts::ReportV1; validation failure returns ReportError & never renders misleading output.
interfaceLock.formats: render_json emits canonical JSON; render_sarif emits SARIF 2.1.0 with report identity/status/gaps/targets/claims plus deterministic rules/results; Markdown & HTML expose status, omissions, findings, locations, providers, evidence, & escape all untrusted content.
interfaceLock.truth: Zero findings never implies PASS; ReportV1 status & gaps remain authoritative & visible. Rendering cannot change completeness, adjudicate findings, invoke providers, execute tools, or claim qualification.
interfaceLock.determinism: Equivalent validated report values render byte-identically; findings use stable semantic ordering & maps use canonical/ordered serialization.

completionChecks: actual changes remain within exact report-crate allowlist & no dependency/lockfile change occurs
focused unit cases prove contract rejection, deterministic ordering, truthful empty/incomplete reports, SARIF fields, & escaping
direct Cargo fmt/check/test/clippy for legion-report pass
application, CLI, Audit, Node/Python, legacy, & Membrane paths remain untouched

workers.executor: Luna Rust worker in isolated worktree; no commit or push
checks: from engine with external CARGO_TARGET_DIR: cargo fmt --all --check
from engine with external CARGO_TARGET_DIR: cargo check -p legion-report --locked
from engine with external CARGO_TARGET_DIR: cargo test -p legion-report --locked
from engine with external CARGO_TARGET_DIR: cargo clippy -p legion-report --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
search changed report files for process execution, filesystem/network effects, Node/Python/Membrane references, unsafe raw HTML, omitted status/gaps, & false-clean wording

stopConditions: source revision or frozen authority changes
worker-owned report path is dirty before execution
implementation requires any path outside exact allowlist
ReportV1 contract change would be required
provider execution, external effect, Node/Python runtime, or Membrane change would be required
